thresholds_note: 30%, 50%, 80% are diagnostic sensitivity thresholds, not policy standards or service guarantees.
warning: Whole-route operation-record shares, not observed arrivals at nearby stations. Current vehicle classifications are conditionally linked to historical records. Facilities remain unreviewed. For each facility, max route lower and max route upper bound the best whole-route record composition; the maxima can come from different routes. Unknown route data contribute [0,1]. Nearby routes may not serve the same destinations or direction and cannot be assumed interchangeable. Facility counts are not passenger demand, waiting time, carbon savings or verified accessibility. Route facility counts overlap and must not be summed.
